notes: Placeholder profile. Every feature stays LOCKED until an address is verified on-device with tools/discover.lua. Do not fill these with guesses.

drone.note: Camera distance/height float. Calibrate by changing the in-game camera setting and diffing.

map.note: Per-unit visibility flag that drives the minimap icon. Diff a hidden vs visible enemy.

aim.note: Local hero lock-on distance. LogicFighter dump offset 0x4A0 is a lead, not a verified address.

damage_phy.note: Live physical attack stat. Locked until damage numbers and enemy HP both move.

damage_mag.note: Live magic power stat. Same calibration gate as physical.
